questions.question: When was the rash first noted and what was the initial assessment?
When was the diet sheet issued and what changes were made to the previous advice?
When was orthostatic hypotension (BP <90 systolic on standing) first documented and how was it managed?
What medications were prescribed, adjusted or discontinued around the time of the diet advice or orthostatic BP finding?
Was any follow-up scheduled before the patient's note requesting no follow-up, and what was its status?
What allergies or adverse reactions were recorded prior to the recent notes, especially if related to diet or medications?
